The Cozy Sleeping Bag provides a buff to experience gain, stacking up to three times in the and in . The bag is not interactable, but instead players will eventually start sleeping while they are standing still on top of it. For each minute, the buff provides 1% of experience gain, up to 3%. It is not usable within rested areas.

Cowabunga is awarded to players who defeat Rasha'nan after all players ride a single wave per cast of Rolling Acid in Nerub-ar Palace on Normal or higher difficulties. This is one of the criteria of Glory of the Nerub-ar Raider. The normal encounter wants players to not get hit by the Rolling Acid waves to avoid the Corrosion debuff by positioning the casting players to point the waves away from the raid. This achievement asks the opposite, with the complication that players need to get hit by exactly one wave, not multiple, on each cast. Coward! is a debuff that a player receives when they flee a Duel to the Death either by escaping its large radius or logging out. Cousin Shortkaf is a grummle located in any neighborhood where Friend of the Grummles is the active endeavor. He appears in the Town Center in Founder's Point or in the Common in Razorwind Shores. He will trade a Kafaccino for five . Kafaccinos can be offered to Sleepy Residents around the neighborhood to perk them up.
